title: A refused commit names each failing rule by id and title
assertion: When `seamspec verify --gate` refuses a commit, its output names each failing rule by id and title and shows the line of the rule's test that failed with what the runner reported, and it does not put the runner's raw output in front of that.

origin.text: prompt: "yes, start part 1 and propose the rules too". Promised in ADR-20261013-4e9b ("To be proposed").
